description: Deterministic pack manifests (pack-manifest-1, canonical JSON edu-canon-json-1). input: the pack as data, with asset files in base64 (keyed by sha256). expect: the exact manifest (manifest_utf8, to be compared byte for byte after UTF-8 encoding), its SHA-256 and size, and every other object with its key, hash and size; or {error: code} when the pack must be refused. All content and all asset bytes are synthetic; the audio bytes are a placeholder that only carries an MP4 signature.

cases.description: A format-2 pack: one lesson with every new block type and question kind, one format-1 lesson, one lesson sharing an image with the first. Lessons are given out of order on purpose; the manifest orders them by position. The shared image appears once.
